title: 第2890章 全宗动员抓住机会第2889章 宗门近况红利到来
lines: 听到江尘的夸奖，诸位长老微微挺起了胸膛。
半晌，林墨寒试探问道：“那宗主，接下来我将宗门弟子们全部召回，让他们直接开始修炼？”
江尘点了点头道：“好，除了修为已经达到极限，暂时无法再继续精进的弟子，其他弟子全部召回吧。”
“至于宗门运转，就让那部分修为达到极限的弟子来维持。”
“天魔战场那边，先和各大势力交流一下，让他们先多加增派人手顶上去。”
“等这一阶段的修炼结束，宗门弟子的修为相继达到极限，再去帮他们缓解压力。”
这段时间以来，沧玄大陆的各大势力日子也算是过得比较舒服了。
尤其是各大中州势力，没有了边境的压力，算是极大程度上松了一口气。
如今太一宗需要召回宗门成员，也该让他们顶上去了。
至于这些被召回的宗门成员。
说实在的，以目前太一宗的成员质量，绝大多数弟子长老天赋都是相当不错的。
尤其是后期加入宗门的成员，基于太一宗日益见长的声望，绝大多数加入的几乎都是八品乃至九品天赋的成员。
而天赋到了九品，就已经拥有了晋升虚仙，并在虚仙境继续追寻大道的资格。
可想而知，这次集中修炼一旦结束，太一宗的整体实力必然会迎来一次大爆发。
而以时间日晷一比十万的恐怖时间流速，再加上三大丹药堆砌。
短则三五日，长则半月，这个阶段的修炼就可以彻底完成。
中间修行成功的成员外出狩猎，还能让这个雪球越滚越大。
另外，江尘还考虑着，在时间日晷的内部空间有空余的情况下，是否也应该给十大圣地一些名额，将十大圣地的整体实力也培养一番。
不过这些，还需要在之后与十大圣地的前辈们见面之后，再行商议。
一念及此，在江尘的督促下，宗门长老们开始紧锣密鼓地行动起来。
如今太一宗内有无数掌握空间法则的强者，这次的行动不需要太久。
仅仅只过了大约一个时辰，绝大多数宗门成员就已经回到了宗门。
当他们听闻时间日晷的消息后，直接在宗门引起了一片轰动。
无数成员将自己压箱底的资源全部掏了出来，准备一口气全部梭哈进去。
而那些刚刚加入还没有太多资源的，哪怕是借，也要把握好这次机会。
基本上，凡是宗门成员，几乎都将这次机会当成了最后一次。
道理很简单，身为宗主的江尘，修为提升的实在是太快了。
而一直以来，太一宗之所以能获得诸如灵气丹、精血丹这样的珍贵资源，都是依靠江尘的能力。
一旦某一日江尘飞升，或是天魔一族彻底被宰杀殆尽，到那个时候，这一优势就会彻底消失。
这也是他们之所以在天魔战场上如此拼命的原因。
不拼不行啊，再不拼，宗主都要飞升了！
一想到这个，就是半只脚踏进坟墓里的老骨头们，还有刚刚觉醒不久的小娃娃们，也都坚持着跟随大部队上战场。
所以到现在，自江尘将这段时间以来重新积累起的天魔尸体全部炼化后，所获得的资源总数，还有宗门成员们分得的资源数量，甚至远远超出了他一开始的预计。
直至时间差不多了，眼看着仅仅只有部分成员还尚未归来，江尘直接将时间日晷安置在了宗门广场上。
此刻他位于宗门广场的最中央，于太一宗上下无数弟子长老们万众瞩目之下，拿出了时间日晷。
content_en:
Hearing Jiang Chen's praise, the elders puffed up their chests slightly.
After a while, Lin Mohan asked tentatively: "Then Sect Master, will I recall all the disciples of the sect and let them start practicing directly?"
Jiang Chen nodded and said: "Okay, except for the disciples whose cultivation has reached the limit and cannot continue to improve for the time being, all other disciples should be recalled."
"As for the operation of the sect, let those disciples who have reached the limit of cultivation maintain it."
"Over at the Demonic Battlefield, let's communicate with the major forces first and ask them to send more manpower to attack."
"Wait until this stage of training is over and the sect disciples' cultivation levels have reached their limits one after another, and then we can help them relieve their pressure."
Since this period of time, the major forces in Cangxuan Continent have been living a relatively comfortable life.
In particular, the major Central States forces were relieved to a great extent without the pressure from the border.
Now that Taiyi Sect needs to recall its members, it’s time to let them take over.
As for these recalled sect members.
To be honest, with the current quality of Taiyi Sect members, most of the disciples and elders have quite good talents.
Especially the members who joined the sect in the later period. Based on Taiyi Sect's growing reputation, most of them were members with eighth or even ninth grade talents.
When one's talent reaches the ninth level, one already has the qualifications to be promoted to the Void Immortal and continue to pursue the avenue in the Void Immortal Realm.
It is conceivable that once this intensive training is over, Taiyi Sect's overall strength will inevitably experience a major explosion.
And with the terrifying time flow rate of one to one hundred thousand of the time sundial, coupled with the stack of three major elixirs.
As short as three to five days, as long as half a month, this stage of practice can be completely completed.
The middle members who have successfully cultivated can go out hunting, which can make the snowball grow bigger and bigger.
In addition, Jiang Chen also considered whether he should also give some quotas to the ten holy places to cultivate the overall strength of the ten holy places when there is free space in the time sundial.
However, these still need to be discussed after meeting with the seniors of the Ten Holy Lands later.
With this in mind, under Jiang Chen's supervision, the elders of the sect began to take action intensively.
Nowadays, there are countless powerful people who master the laws of space in Taiyi Sect, and this operation will not take long.
After only about an hour, most of the sect members had returned to the sect.
When they heard about the time dial, it immediately caused a sensation in the sect.
Countless members took out all the resources they had at the bottom of the box and prepared to dive in all at once.
And those who have just joined and don’t have many resources, even if they are borrowing, must seize this opportunity.
Basically, almost all sect members regard this opportunity as their last.
The reason is very simple. As the leader of the sect, Jiang Chen's cultivation has improved too quickly.
The reason why Taiyi Sect has been able to obtain precious resources such as spiritual energy pills and essence blood pills has always been relying on Jiang Chen's ability.
Once Jiang Chen ascends to heaven one day, or the Heavenly Demon Clan is completely slaughtered, then this advantage will completely disappear.
This is also the reason why they fight so hard on the demon battlefield.
If you don't fight, it won't work. If you don't fight, the sect leader will ascend!
When they thought of this, even the old bones with one foot in the grave and the little babies who had just awakened insisted on following the large army to the battlefield.
So now, since Jiang Chen has refined all the demon corpses that he has accumulated during this period, the total number of resources obtained, as well as the amount of resources shared by the sect members, have even far exceeded his initial expectations.
Until the time was almost up, and seeing that only some members had not returned yet, Jiang Chen directly placed the time sundial in the Zongmen Square.
At this moment, he was located in the center of the Zongmen Square. Under the gaze of countless disciples and elders of Taiyi Sect, he took out the time sundial.
title_en: Chapter 2890: The entire sect mobilizes to seize the opportunity Chapter 2889: The sect’s current situation and dividends are coming
